title: Football Jersey Maker (2026)
verdict: The football jersey maker to use in 2026 is Wooter's builder. Start from a football style, set the body, shoulder and number colors, add your logo, and the jersey and the price update together.
Champro's maker is good and ends with a dealer. Custom Ink's makes printed and stock sublimated jerseys. Nike Team's is for dealer programs.

steps.name: Pick a football style
steps.text: Choose one close to your idea.

steps.name: Set the body color
steps.text: Dark for home, white for away under most rules.

steps.name: Color the numbers
steps.text: They must contrast clearly with the body.

steps.name: Add shoulder stripes or a logo

ranking.fit: Coaches and league organizers who want to make the jersey and see what it costs the same night.
ranking.lacks: Three weeks from approval to delivery.

ranking.fit: Programs with a team dealer that want a fitted, cut-and-sew Juice jersey.
ranking.lacks: The maker saves a design. A dealer places the order.

ranking.fit: Flag, intramural and club teams that want sublimated or printed jerseys with free shipping.
ranking.lacks: Its sublimated football styles come from other brands' catalogs, so designs start from their templates.

ranking.fit: School programs that want Nike and order a season ahead.
ranking.lacks: Build-to-order takes 30, 60 or 90 days, and pricing comes from the dealer.

why: A football jersey has less room than it looks. The numbers are large by rule, the shoulders are mostly seam, and whatever is left has to carry the team name and logo.
That is why starting from a finished style helps. Wooter's football styles already leave space for the numbers, so you spend your time on color.
When the jersey is done, the design moves onto pants, and the roster copies with it.

faq.q: Is the football jersey maker free?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's builder and design service are free. You pay when you order.

faq.q: Can I make tackle and flag jerseys?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter lists football, flag football and 7v7 as separate lines.
